title: Atomic shared-tool and integrity-receipt promotion
failure_signature: A reviewed shared-tool correction was staged while its inherited canonical-index-blob integrity receipt still named the prior tool version.
trigger_preconditions: tool-integrity receipt is rebuildable from the Git index
full suite includes an integrity equality test
candidate_workaround: Rebuild the selected-tool receipt from staged Git index blobs, inspect the exact changed row, and promote the tool and receipt in one additive commit.
recurrence_guard: Treat a selected-tool diff and its integrity receipt as one review unit; run the targeted rebuild before the full repository suite.
rollback: Leave the unpromoted tool and receipt staged, retain the failed suite, and do not send a baton until their targeted rebuild agrees.
scope_boundary: Validated only for local selected-tool integrity bookkeeping; not exhaustive supply-chain assurance, security certification, or independent reproduction.
